checks: Source coefficients, assignments, plant parameters and coverage
Saved design matrices and nominal controller identity
Profile array hashes and array dimensions
Metric finiteness, duration and feasibility consistency

replay.selection: All six methods and two scenarios for seed 1311/client 0, plus maximum-RMSE case for each local baseline/scenario; no outcome replacement.
replay.scope: Sampled reconstruction only. Original committed metrics remain authoritative; no new scientific fleet and no full 3600-case replay certification.

recommendation: Include as descriptive supporting control validation with explicit baseline failures, modest Global-relative gains and recipient tradeoffs. No manuscript edits made.
aggregation: Equal clients within fleet, then equal fleets. Percent reductions are means of paired fleet-relative reductions. No inferential claims.
